subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer-labeled prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into existing sub-agent guidance, changed into a coherent no-nested-spawn policy, or manually closed as already covered?
rationale: The branch is small, but it changes maintainer-owned model prompt policy where current main already has overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only the useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and every prompt surface together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is sufficient, a maintainer can close this protected stale branch manually rather than carrying duplicate prompt text.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only the useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, child-prompt, or tool-description surfaces after rebasing.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the maintainer-labeled prompt-policy PR and already made the product-direction call against the related tool-policy approach.
